function.name: search_aya_companies
function.description: Search the AYA public index of organizations rated for AI readability. Returns companies matching the query by name, domain, sector, or country, sorted by AIO score (0-100). The AIO score measures how well a website's structured data can be understood by AI systems. Use this when a user asks about a specific company, wants to find companies in a given sector or country, or wants to check if a company is indexed in AYA.

query.description: Search term: company name (e.g. 'Nestle'), domain (e.g. 'adobe.com'), sector (e.g. 'finance'), or country (e.g. 'Switzerland'). Case-insensitive, partial match supported.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-200). Default: 50.

function.name: get_aya_entity
function.description: Get the full AYA record for a specific entity by its canonical domain. Returns complete data including identity, AIO scoring with all 7 block scores, ASR_DERIVED structured data (services, compliance, indicators), and recommendability signals. Use this when you need detailed information about one specific company.

domain.description: Canonical domain of the entity (e.g. 'adobe.com', 'nestle.com'). Do not include 'www.' or 'https://'.

function.name: get_aya_stats
function.description: Get aggregate statistics about the entire AYA index: total entities, certified vs indexed breakdown, average/min/max/median AIO scores, and entity count per sector and country. Use this to provide context about the index or when comparing a specific entity's score to the average.
